collinearity.caveat: Among 11 spread axes, `hidden size` tracks loss most strongly, but it moves with `total parameters` (-0.89), `active parameters` (+0.89), `active / total parameters` (+0.89), `contracted FLOPs/token` (+0.89), `dense-runtime FLOPs/token` (+0.89), `measured throughput` (-0.76), `expert width` (-0.71) at |rho| >= 0.7, so this set cannot separate them.

axis_association.multiple_comparisons: 12 axes tested uncorrected; treat any single marginal p-value as a hypothesis, not a result. Exact p-values are enumerated over n! arrangements and are not comparable to a chi-square test.

joint_structural_fit.caveat: Coefficients are standardised and each p-value is two-sided against a permutation null, but predictors are collinear by construction here, so a coefficient surviving the model does not mean the underlying lever is identified. Use a designed set to separate them.; `hidden_size` and `expert_width` move together at rho=-0.71 and cannot be told apart at this size, so their split in the fit is arbitrary.

hidden_size.reading: the levels disagree in sign, so the pooled contrast is an average of opposite effects and neither level's number can be read off it

compute_units.reason: no shorter length to fit a slope

head_pairing_decision.label: HEAD EFFECT IS REAL AT WIDE WIDTH
head_pairing_decision.reading: The level dependence is real: more attention heads help at wide residual-stream width and do not at narrow. A search over this family must mutate `attention_heads` *jointly* with `hidden_size` - the free lever is only free at wide widths, so "add heads" is a rule with a precondition rather than a global one.
head_pairing_decision.note: The pooled head contrast clears the threshold on a sign-inconsistent set of pairs, so it is a systematic average of disagreeing units rather than a uniform head effect - the level split above is what says which levels produce it, and it is the reason that split is reported rather than inferred from this average. **The branch is reading-dependent**: on the same rows, with only the loss field substituted, the rule lands on `INTERACTION ABSENT - THE THREE-SEED AGREEMENT WAS SEED LUCK` under `mean_train_loss`. The design, the seeds and the declared thresholds are unchanged, so the branch to quote is the pre-registered one - held-out validation loss - and the reading that moves it is named here rather than left to a reader who tries the other.
